2993.title: Supervisor does not stop after a server-port takeover
2993.rootCauseOneLine: The server restart loop does not probe for a healthy replacement owner and therefore has no stop path.
2993.proposedFix: Probe the configured health URL after server exit, stop the remaining daemon when a valid healthy server answers, and otherwise retain the existing restart behavior.
2993.caveats: The reproduction controls retry timing and uses a real healthy loopback server. The existing suite separately verifies that a foreign healthy server makes the managed child startup fail.
